title: Record the authoritative upstream source and synchronization baseline
abstract: For an authorized Rust fork maintenance task, identify the intended upstream repository and remote, the branch or release being followed, and the last verified upstream commit incorporated into the fork. Do not infer upstream identity from similarly named remotes or unrelated repositories.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only separately authorized work on an existing Rust fork and its explicitly identified upstream; neither queueing nor this proposed requirement authorizes repository edits, upstream integrations, releases, or unrelated work.

remarks: Normalized and published as NOM-0129; no rule application or unrelated repository action.
